remarks: Beautiful townhouse in the heart of Wilton Town Center ready for  IMMEDIATE occupancy. This unit is meticulously maintained and  updated for today's lifestyle. Well appointed kitchen with breakfast bar that opens to dining room. Spacious living room with fireplace and sliders to one of two decks. Second floor features two ensuite bedrooms with updated bathrooms and plenty of closet space. Finished space on lower level is perfect for a home office, toy room or exercise equipment. Attached garage. Ideal location, walk to train, parks, NRVT, restaurants, stores, library. Get in before the start of school year. Multi year lease available.
